crossRefs.note: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of…
that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.
For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
“The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal…
You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.
as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by…
For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation…
But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand…
For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord…
Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ…

By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

translations.web: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
translations.bsb: For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.
translations.kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
translations.asv: For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only use not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another.
